value.deck: Microsoft Fabric's Item Recovery feature will be enabled by default for tenants that haven't explicitly disabled it, providing automatic protection against accidental deletion.
shortVersion: Here is the simple version: Microsoft Fabric's Item Recovery feature will be enabled by default for tenants that haven't explicitly disabled it, providing automatic protection against accidental deletion.
Default-on recovery for Fabric items is a welcome safety net for data platform teams; organizations should review their Fabric governance policies ahead of this change.
